description: Use this when the user asks what architecture to see in a city, a neighbourhood or near a place, for buildings by an architect or a studio, of a type, style, material or period, or for ideas for an architecture trip or walk. Searches the more than 32,000 works in Builtalist, from all over the world, and gives up to 20, the most notable first (essential, then featured), each with its architects, year, place and link, plus a link to see them all on the Builtalist map. All filters are optional and combine.

arquitecto.description: An architect or a studio, or part of the name: "Siza", "Herzog & de Meuron", "Lina Bo Bardi".

cerca.description: Around a point, for "near me" or "near this place".

radio_km.description: Radius in km, up to 50. 2 if not given.

ciudad.description: A city, by its English name as in the catalogue: Porto, Lisbon, Munich, New York, Rome.

desde.description: Built in this year or later. Years BC are negative.

etiquetas.description: Only works with all these tags: CON = exposed concrete, LAD = brick, MAD = wood, PIE = stone, ArtDeco = Art Deco, Brutalism = Brutalism, ChicagoSchool = Chicago School, Eclecticism = Eclecticism, Georgian = Georgian, Gothic = Gothic, Historicism = Historicism, InternationalStyle = International Style, Modernism = Modernism, Neoclassicism = Neoclassicism, Postmodernism = Postmodernism, Rationalism = Rationalism, RenaissanceBaroque = Renaissance and Baroque, SecondModernity = second modernity, Victorian = Victorian, CNC = came out of a competition, COM = commercial, CUL = cultural, EDU = education, GOV = civic, HOT = hospitality, IND = industrial, INT = interior design, MIX = mixed use, MUS = museum, PUB = public space, REL = religious, RES = housing, Reuse = adaptive reuse, SIN = special-purpose building, SPO = sports, TMP = temporary architecture, TRA = transport.

hasta.description: Built in this year or earlier.

limite.description: How many works to give, from 1 to 20. 10 if not given.

orden.description: With "cerca", "cercanas" sorts by distance. By default, the most notable first.

pais.description: A country, in English or Spanish: Portugal, Japan, United States, España.

rango.description: esencial: only the essential works (the must-sees of their city); destacada: the essential and the featured ones.

texto.description: Words to look for in the name, the architects, the neighbourhood, the city and the keywords of each work (materials, features and uses: glass, brick, courtyard, cantilever, church, library…), in English or Spanish. With several words, works with more of them come first.

visitable.description: Only works that can be visited inside.
